# Source fixture provenance

`bybit.html`, `bitget.html`, `mexc.html`: synthetic parser examples, not live captures.

`bybit-live-listing.html`: public `__NEXT_DATA__` fields extracted on 2026-10-08 from
https://announcements.bybit.com/ru-RU/?category=latest_activities (HTTP 200).

`bybit-live-article.html`: public `__NEXT_DATA__` article fields extracted on the same date from
https://announcements.bybit.com/ru-RU/article/bypick-season-1-free-picks-to-earn-points-towards-sharing-a-100-000-usdt-prize-pool--art8fd5d30ccc24/?category=latest_activities (HTTP 200).

Only listing/article data are retained; unrelated analytics and executable scripts are excluded. The conflicting CMS deadline and campaign-text time are preserved as evidence. Fixtures do not prove future source availability.
